item.title: Strong Winds Rip Roof Off CA Fire Station
item.description: Strong winds from a thunderstorm damaged a Fresno County (CA) fire station, ripping off its roof and affecting the garage. No crews were inside, and service response times remain unaffected. The post Strong Winds Rip Roof Off CA Fire Station appeared first on Fire Apparatus: Fire trucks, fire engines, emergency vehicles, and firefighting equipment.

item.title: Lessons from the Shop Floor: What Every Officer Should Know About Their Apparatus
